title: How do step distributions aggregate across cards, landmarks and the Workbench?
question: How do step distributions aggregate across cards, landmarks and the Workbench?
answer:
LD-24: A Task can appear under every related destination question but counts once in the shared landmark percentage breakdown. Preserve all relationships without duplicate contribution.
LD-25: First version: each distinct item contributes equally regardless of type. Evolve weighting later as Tracker usefulness is proven; not a permanent invariant.
LD-27: Each distinct item contributes one total unit, split into step fractions when mixed. Sum contributions per step, divide by distinct item count. Same calculation for destination questions, landmarks, Workbench-wide views; shared items count once.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: LD-24, LD-25, LD-27 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
